summary_en: France Bed executed a block trade on November 9, 2026, acquiring 321,500 shares at ¥1,244 per share for a total of ¥399.946 million via ToSTNeT-3, representing 0.96% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, France Bed's board of directors authorized a treasury stock acquisition under Article 459, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Companies Act and decided to execute a block trade. The company acquired 321,500 ordinary shares through ToSTNeT-3, an off-hours trading facility operated by the Tokyo Stock Exchange, on November 9, 2026, at a fixed price of ¥1,244 per share, for a total outlay of ¥399.946 million. This execution represents 0.96% of the 33,415,000 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026.

The acquisition was conducted as a buy order placed at 8:45 a.m. on the execution date, valid only for that specific trading time window. The order matched against existing sell orders in the market. Following this ToSTNeT-3 execution, the company plans to continue treasury stock acquisitions through open market purchases from November 10, 2026, through March 31, 2027, up to the remaining limit of the board authorization (900,000 shares maximum and ¥1 billion maximum, approved on November 6, 2026 for the period through March 31, 2027).
